title: Custom Trees
body:
# Custom Trees Plugin 
> Replace boring vanilla Minecraft Trees using Custom Trees plugin. Highly optmised for large scalale servers.

![Example Trees](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b70f36b657bd0214750fc264742e439da9d8221.png)

## Features
1. Pre-loaded `schematics`.
2. Easily add your own `.schem` or `.schematic` files.
3. Each Tree has 3 versions , choosen at random.


## How it works
> Replaces any tree grown from sapling using bonemeal.


## Dependencies:
- FastAsyncWorldEdit


## Installation
1. Install [FastAsyncWorldEdit](https://modrinth.com/plugin/fastasyncworldedit) into your `plugins` folder.
2. Drop `CustomTrees.jar` into your `plugins` folder.
3. Restart your server.
4. Plant a sapling, use bone meal, and watch your custom trees grow!
